entities.summary: Friedrich Julius Reubke was a German composer, pianist and organist associated with the school of Romanticism. A pupil of Franz Liszt, his small œuvre includes the Sonata on the 94th Psalm in C minor, renowned as one of the finest organ works in the romantic repertoire. Julius Reubke was a composers & musicians from Hausneindorf (1834-03-23, Hausneindorf–1858-06-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
